description: Invalid documents and the diagnostics both compilers report for them, as <code>@<line> in the order reported. The TypeScript compiler is held to it by Conformance/for_Conformance/when_holding_the_compilers_to_the_diagnostic_vectors and the C# compiler by Syntax/Serialization/for_SyntaxJson/when_holding_the_typescript_compiler_to_its_diagnostics. Each case only exercises what the TypeScript compiler reads; the constructs it skips are reported by the C# compiler alone. Cases with validate: true run C# Compile rather than Parse to include validation; TypeScript parse includes these checks.
